```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(multcomp)
theme_set(theme_bw())
```

# 1 Introduction

"Put introduction here. Motivate the study, provide background, and state scientific questions."

## Data Description

"Describe the dataset source, observational units, key variables, and units here."

```{r load-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load the data
housing <- read.csv("housing.csv")

# Create reduced dataset similar to class examples
housing_reduced <- housing %>%
  select(SalePrice, Gr.Liv.Area, Overall.Qual, Year.Built,
         Neighborhood, House.Style, Full.Bath, Bedroom.AbvGr,
         Garage.Cars, Total.Bsmt.SF, Lot.Area) %>%
  filter(complete.cases(.)) %>%
  mutate(
    Neighborhood = factor(Neighborhood),
    House.Style = factor(House.Style)
  )

# Optional: set baseline levels to mirror course examples
housing_reduced <- housing_reduced %>%
  mutate(
    Neighborhood = fct_relevel(Neighborhood, "NAmes"),
    House.Style = fct_relevel(House.Style, "1Story")
  )

### Exploratory summaries

```{r price-distribution, fig.height=5, fig.width=8, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
housing_reduced %>%
  select(SalePrice, Gr.Liv.Area, Overall.Qual, Total.Bsmt.SF, Garage.Cars) %>%
  summary()
```

### Sale price distribution

```{r sale-price-distribution, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
ggplot(housing_reduced, aes(x = SalePrice)) +
  geom_histogram(fill = "steelblue", color = "white", bins = 30) +
  labs(x = "Sale Price ($)", y = "Count") +
  theme_bw()
```

### Living area vs. sale price

```{r living-area-plot, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
ggplot(housing_reduced, aes(x = Gr.Liv.Area, y = SalePrice)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red") +
  labs(x = "Above-Grade Living Area (sq ft)",
       y = "Sale Price ($)") +
  theme_bw()
```

### Neighborhood differences

```{r neighborhood-plot, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
ggplot(housing_reduced,
       aes(x = reorder(Neighborhood, SalePrice, FUN = median),
           y = SalePrice)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Neighborhood", y = "Sale Price ($)") +
  theme_bw()
```

# 2 Model Selection and Validation

"State the modeling strategy here, including rationale for variable inclusion and any preprocessing steps."

\[
\text{SalePrice}_i = \beta_0 + \beta_1\,\text{Gr.Liv.Area}_i + \beta_2\,\text{Overall.Qual}_i +
\beta_3\,\text{Year.Built}_i + \beta_4\,\text{Neighborhood}_i + \beta_5\,\text{House.Style}_i +
\beta_6\,\text{Full.Bath}_i + \beta_7\,\text{Bedroom.AbvGr}_i + \beta_8\,\text{Garage.Cars}_i +
\beta_9\,\text{Total.Bsmt.SF}_i + \beta_{10}\,\text{Lot.Area}_i + \varepsilon_i,
\]

"Explain the error assumptions and link back to the scientific question here."

```{r data-prep, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Use the reduced housing data for modeling
model_data <- housing_reduced
```

# 3 Analyses, Results, and Interpretation

## Full main-effects model

```{r mlr-model, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Fit initial model
mlr_model <- lm(SalePrice ~ ., data = model_data)

# Model summary
summary(mlr_model)

full_coefs <- coef(summary(mlr_model)) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Term")

full_coefs
```

"Interpret the full-model output here, including notable coefficients and uncertainty."

## Design matrix illustration

```{r design-matrix, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
X_mat <- model.matrix(mlr_model)
set.seed(330)
X_mat[sample(1:nrow(X_mat), 10), ]
```

## Model diagnostics

```{r diagnostics, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Model diagnostics
diagnostics <- tibble(
  fitted = fitted(mlr_model),
  residual = resid(mlr_model),
  std_resid = rstandard(mlr_model)
)

# Residuals vs Fitted values
ggplot(diagnostics, aes(x = fitted, y = residual)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Residuals vs Fitted Values",
       x = "Fitted Values",
       y = "Residuals") +
  theme_minimal()

# QQ plot of residuals
ggplot(diagnostics, aes(sample = std_resid)) +
  stat_qq() +
  stat_qq_line(color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Normal Q-Q Plot of Standardized Residuals",
       x = "Theoretical Quantiles",
       y = "Sample Quantiles") +
  theme_minimal()
```

"Discuss diagnostic findings here and comment on model assumptions."

## Reduced model comparison

"Explain selection of reduced model and how it compares to the full model."

```{r reduced-model, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
reduced_model <- lm(
  SalePrice ~ Gr.Liv.Area + Overall.Qual + Neighborhood + Garage.Cars + Total.Bsmt.SF,
  data = model_data
)

summary(reduced_model)

# Compare reduced and full models (both main-effect models)
anova(reduced_model, mlr_model)

reduced_coefs <- coef(summary(reduced_model)) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("Term")

reduced_coefs
```

"Summarize reduced model performance and implications here."

## Selected contrasts with multcomp

```{r contrasts, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
contrast_matrix <- rbind(
  "CollgCr vs. NAmes" = c(0, 0, 0, 0, 1, rep(0, ncol(model_matrix <- model.matrix(mlr_model)) - 5))
)

neighborhood_contrast <- glht(mlr_model, linfct = contrast_matrix)
summary(neighborhood_contrast)
confint(neighborhood_contrast)
```

## Profile-based prediction example

```{r profile-prediction, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
new_profile <- tibble(
  Gr.Liv.Area = 2000,
  Overall.Qual = 7,
  Year.Built = 2005,
  Neighborhood = factor("CollgCr", levels = levels(model_data$Neighborhood)),
  House.Style = factor("1Story", levels = levels(model_data$House.Style)),
  Full.Bath = 2,
  Bedroom.AbvGr = 3,
  Garage.Cars = 2,
  Total.Bsmt.SF = 900,
  Lot.Area = median(model_data$Lot.Area)
)

predict(mlr_model, newdata = new_profile, interval = "confidence")
predict(mlr_model, newdata = new_profile, interval = "prediction")
```
